====================
create schema
====================

CREATE SCHEMA people;
CREATE SCHEMA std.invoke;

---

(source_file
  (create_schema_statement
    (kw_create)
    (kw_schema)
    name: (qualified_name
      (identifier))
    (semicolon))
  (create_schema_statement
    (kw_create)
    (kw_schema)
    name: (qualified_name
      (identifier)
      (dot)
      (identifier))
    (semicolon)))

====================
create schema lowercase keywords
====================

create schema demo;

---

(source_file
  (create_schema_statement
    (kw_create)
    (kw_schema)
    name: (qualified_name
      (identifier))
    (semicolon)))

====================
create schema accepts keyword-initial qualified names
====================

CREATE SCHEMA SELECT;
CREATE SCHEMA SELECT.FROM;

---

(source_file
  (create_schema_statement
    (kw_create)
    (kw_schema)
    name: (qualified_name
      (kw_select))
    (semicolon))
  (create_schema_statement
    (kw_create)
    (kw_schema)
    name: (qualified_name
      (kw_select)
      (dot)
      (kw_from))
    (semicolon)))
